classification.probe-native: Eleven exact helper summaries: helper removal, known R11 residuals, saved-RBP input recovery and return-slot observability. The zero residual permits ordinary unsigned identity typing. No changed controls.
classification.probe-buffer: The same eleven probes plus one4096-byte buffer whose complete C body remains intact except helper removal. Both optional physical stack policies retain the original call by focused tests.
classification.probe-upstream: Five independently inventoried helper callers. create_note/decompress_zlib only lose the helper. add_file coalesces duplicate a0 copies and reorders independent assignments. ctr reorders zero/copy assignments with equal-value storage merging. Object::section propagates three parameter copies and consistently renumbers three surviving locals.

metadata_review: All variable identity/storage deltas agree across C/Rust/Go; explicit type-spelling mapping checks their corresponding language types. Dead synthesized spills appear as unused undefined8 metadata with no printed uses. Unused gaps split around those slots; this does not shrink emitted buffers. Object::section drops three copied parameter locals, retains unused storage records and consistently renumbers the surviving locals. R11 undefined register values disappear; saved-RBP forwarding recovers the source input. Line numbers are in range and track removed calls, propagated copies and renumbering.
limitations: Page-touch reads and faults deliberately abstracted.
Cross-language Rust literal sanitization remains a separate known limitation.
No native execution of supplied upstream executable.
